spans.s:
डिम् डिम् (a Sautra root or one not occur-
ring in the Dhātu-pāṭha), to hurt, injure.

डिम डिम, अस्, m. a dramatic entertainment,
dramatic exhibition of battle or siege, such as the
Tripura-dāha, in which the destruction of the three
cities of Tripura by Śiva is dramatised; a kind of
mixed caste.

डिम्ब डिम्ब, अस्, m. affray, riot, conflict
without weapons, mutual defiance, petty and predatory
war, &c. [cf. डमर]; sound or noise occasioned
by terror; an egg; a chrysalis; the embryo in the
first stage of its existence; a new-born child, any young
animal; the bladder, the spleen, the lungs; the
uterus; a globe or ball.
—डिम्ब-युद्ध, अम्, n.
or डिम्बाहव (˚ब-आह्˚), अस्, m. petty warfare,
affray, skirmish, riot, &c.
डिम्भ् डिम्भ् or डिम्ब्. See rt. डिप् above.

डिम्भ डिम्भ, अस्, m. a new-born child,
any young animal; a fool, an idiot, a blockhead;
(आ), f. an infant.
—डिम्भ-चक्र, अम्, n. a mystical
circle; a diagram for telling fortunes.

डिम्भक, अस्, इका, m. f. a new-born child, young
animal; (अस्), m., N. of a general of Jarā-sandha,
younger brother of Haṃsa and son of Brahma-datta.
